title: The Last God - my first game after like 15years of trying, finally ready
author: goblingamescompany
selftext:
Hi all! Title says it all, finally made it and Claude was the catalyst to make it happen.

The Steam page is finally live: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5376910/The\_Last\_God/?beta=0

"The gods took someone from you. Nothing that has stopped dying remembers what a life is worth. You cursed them all, and something answered with an offer: your vengeance, for your life. A dark roguelike auto-shooter. Make every pantheon answer."

I love Diablo, Hades and really enjoyed the chaos of Vampire Survivors. So I tried to jam the concepts together and took a bit of the Mega Man mechanic of taking the powers to use and help progress.

Jam that all into a rogue like loop and that's The Last God.

AI was used across every aspect of the process and I'll be working to get a workflow guide out there as well. In summary:

\- Claude Desktop using Code with Pro Plan

\- Replicate MCP for art and music

\- Unity

Happy to answer any questions or feedback! Of course a wishlist is appreciated 😅

Here's my page with more info too: https://goblingames.world/games/the-last-god/
